keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «할아버지가 사진마다 이야기를 들려주며 함께 웃은 일(사건)» 과 «사진이 가족의 추억을 살아 있게 하고 더 가깝게 해 준다는 깨달음(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the event (Grandpa told a story about each photo and they laughed together) and the lesson (photos keep family memories alive and bring us closer). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: They looked at old family photos and shared stories.
Photos keep family memories alive and bring us closer.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why was every photo special with Grandpa's film camera?
qs.qko: 할아버지의 필름 카메라로 찍은 사진은 왜 한 장 한 장이 특별했나요?
opts: You could not see the pictures right away.
The camera was made of gold.
evs: "That is my film camera," Grandpa said with a smile.
"You cannot see the pictures right away, so every photo was special."
One rainy day, Ara found an old camera in Grandpa's closet.
He took out a heavy box full of old photo albums.
why: 사진을 바로 볼 수 없어서 한 장 한 장이 특별했다고 할아버지가 말했어요.
Grandpa says you cannot see the pictures right away, so every photo was special.

qs.q: What does "keep our family memories alive" mean?
qs.qko: «가족의 추억을 살아 있게 한다» 는 말은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: help us remember our family's past
make old photos move like a video
keep family members from getting sick
evs: Grandpa told her a story about each photo, and they laughed together for hours.
One rainy day, Ara found an old camera in Grandpa's closet.
He took out a heavy box full of old photo albums.
The next weekend, she took pictures of the family having dinner together.
why: 할아버지는 사진을 보며 옛날 일을 떠올려 이야기해 주었어요. 사진이 지난 일을 기억하게 해 준다는 뜻이에요.
Grandpa remembered a story for each photo. So photos help us remember the past.

qs.q: How do we know Ara wanted to make her own family photos?
qs.qko: 아라가 직접 가족 사진을 남기고 싶어 했다는 것을 어떻게 알 수 있나요?
opts: She learned to use the film camera and took family photos.
She threw the old camera away.
She asked Grandpa for a new phone.
evs: Ara asked Grandpa to teach her how to use the film camera.
The next weekend, she took pictures of the family having dinner together.
One rainy day, Ara found an old camera in Grandpa's closet.
There was a picture of the whole family at the beach many years ago.
why: 아라는 필름 카메라 쓰는 법을 배우고 싶어 했고, 다음 주말에 가족 사진을 찍었어요. 두 문장을 이으면 알 수 있어요.
Ara asked Grandpa to teach her the camera, and the next weekend she took pictures of her family.

ends: Ara and Grandpa print her new photos and make an album.
아라와 할아버지가 새 사진을 뽑아 앨범을 만들어요.
Ara takes the film camera on her school trip.
아라가 필름 카메라를 들고 학교 소풍을 가요.

write.src: “I want to <u>take a photo of my family</u> because <u>photos keep our memories alive</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because she tells funny stories)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because she tells funny stories)
